genotype_to_drug_rule: Fits scikit-learn 1.7.2 LogisticRegression(penalty='elasticnet', solver='saga') over 4 mixes x 10 log-spaced penalties selected by pooled class-balanced log loss on 3 inner folds with feature screening and SD scaling strictly inside each inner/outer training fold; refits on outer training fold; calls R at score >= 0.5.

i_handling.description: Elastic net outputs continuous probabilities thresholded at 0.5 (>=0.5 -> R, <0.5 -> S); null/unconverged fits fall back to outer training prevalence and any failed genome is counted separately and never mapped to S.
